title: Lenovo Legion Go Beam Leaked as Potential Budget Handheld PC
excerpt: A leak suggests Lenovo may soon announce a new handheld gaming PC called the Legion Go Beam, potentially offering a more affordable option.
body_html:
A potential new handheld gaming PC from Lenovo has surfaced through a leak. Dubbed the Lenovo Legion Go Beam, the device could offer an alternative in a market where pricing for similar portable gaming computers has often climbed significantly, with some models ranging from $1,000 to $2,000.

While official details and pricing have not been confirmed by the manufacturer, the leak points to the possibility of a more budget-friendly option for consumers looking for handheld gaming hardware.
